#!/bin/bash

# background_tasks.sh - Perform various background maintenance tasks

# Function to log messages with timestamp
log_message() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] $1"
}

# Start logging
log_message "Starting background tasks"

# Task 1: Check disk usage
log_message "Checking disk usage..."
df -h | grep -v "tmpfs\|udev" >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1

# Task 2: Check system memory
log_message "Checking memory usage..."
free -h >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1

# Task 3: Check running processes (top 5 by CPU)
log_message "Checking top CPU processes..."
ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -6 >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1

# Task 4: Check network connections
log_message "Checking network connections..."
ss -tuln >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1

# Task 5: Update package lists (if we have permissions)
log_message "Updating package lists..."
if command -v apt &> /dev/null; then
    apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | head -10 >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1
elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
    yum check-update >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1
fi

# Task 6: Check for failed systemd services
log_message "Checking for failed services..."
systemctl --failed >> /tmp/background_tasks.log 2>&1

# Task 7: Clean up old log entries in our log file (keep last 100 lines)
log_message "Cleaning up log file..."
if [ -f "/tmp/background_tasks.log" ]; then
    tail -100 /tmp/background_tasks.log > /tmp/background_tasks.log.tmp
    mv /tmp/background_tasks.log.tmp /tmp/background_tasks.log
fi

# Task 8: Create a timestamp file to indicate when this script last ran
echo "Last run: $(date)" > /tmp/background_tasks_last_run.txt

log_message "Background tasks completed"

# background-tasks.service - Background Tasks Service
# This service runs periodic system maintenance and monitoring tasks

[Unit]
Description=Background Tasks Service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/tmp/background_tasks.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

# Security settings
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

# Logging
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
